name: Station 2, the rille (PLAN.md section 7): tube_god_07's collapsed stretch on the head step (the plain at ~2,990 m, the rille's floor ~2,870 m), its colonnaded walls stepping on the flows' tops, a spring at a palagonite parting feeding a stream and the Talovolci's red stalk fields on the floor; past the rille's end the tube roofed under the plain with its pit chain, hornitos and a fresh collapse, and one skylight walked down into the tube through the gathered caves; early summer
